notes.title: Quick update - Deiland: Pocket Planet Post-release
notes.content:
Hi there friends,

It's been a few days since the release of Deiland: Pocket Planet on Steam. First of all, we would like to thank you all for your support and patience during launch day. 

As you may know from a previous update, we have parted ways with our previous publisher and it have not been possible to transfer the ownership of the packages. That is the reason we had to re-release the game on Steam and decided to send you a key to everyone who has the original game in their library. Also, although the original game has been retired, keep in mind that you are still able to play the original Deiland.  

We are receiving tons of emails in our inbox regarding this topic and we would like to let you know that we are extending the free upgrade request until the end of this week. We are a small team, but there is a member of the team already going through all the emails, so please bear with us if you haven't received your answer yet. 

But this release it is not just only a relaunch of the original game. We wanted to include new content in this edition. The reimagination of Deiland includes new unique content not included in the original version: new looks, new music, new playability, and the exclusive DLC content released on the previous game. On top of all of this, this new edition includes a new “seasons'' system.

However, even including new content the game shares the same code as the original version, and as many of you pointed out, the game is not fully compatible to play with keyboard. We added a quick fix that made mouse and keyboard controls works, but we highly encourage to play this game with a controller. 

If you have been playing Deiland and you have enjoyed the game so far, we would like to kindly ask you to leave a positive review. It is a huge help and it would be the world for us! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022819/9191e9688f79276d5838191b35728c1deca58616.png[/img]

notes.title: Summer in Mara Physical Collector's Edition on its way!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We’re back another day with exciting news. We started Chibig with an idea in our minds: to create a colorful and relaxing universe that the player would fall in love with. After Deiland: Pocket Planet, Summer in Mara, and now Ankora: Lost Days, we’re getting there, step by step. 

Now, we’re happy to announce that our universe is getting bigger thanks to Tesura Games, a Spanish physical publisher that will help us to carry our worlds to your hands. We had signed a partnership with them to take our games to the physical world and now it’s time for Summer in Mara. 

Thanks to Tesura, Summer in Mara will be released in physical, both in standard and Collector’s Edition, for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 (but you can play it on your Playstation 5). 

And this is everything it includes: 
[list]
[*] Game
[*] Collector's Box
[*] Artbook
[*] Napopo pin
[*] Diorama
[*] Double-Sided Poster
[*] Stickers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022819/61c802b64b901845884dc15df3b7807015bcfb9d.png[/img]

If you would like to have Deiland: Pocket Planet in a physical edition, Ankora: Lost Days will have a physical edition only for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation, which will also include Deiland: Pocket Planet. You'll get both games in the same cartridge and disc. This is a special edition, with a unique cover for the backers of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022819/c44f112f5d515ab341335fc374fb75cc52979bcc.png[/img]

Also, if you are looking to have the whole Chibig's universe in your hands, we have created two new Tier Rewards. 

The first one is the same as the Ankora Collector’s Edition with the Summer in Mara Standard Edition and a Digital Copy of Summer in Mara for the platform of your choice (Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4, Xbox One or Steam).

The second one is a very special Chibig Universe Edition: at last, both of our games in a Special Collector’s Edition. You will get both Ankora: Lost Days and Summer in Mara with everything that contains its Collector’s Edition.

Since Summer in Mara in physical will be released way before Ankora: Lost Days, we’re going to send you the physical edition for the game before everything else. We can’t say a day yet, but wait for it very soon! 

Although it isn't a final date confirmed for this physical edition yet, we are pretty confident it will be available before the end of this year. So stay tuned and see you in Mara!

notes.title: Ankora, our new cute-as-heck exploration adventure, is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi there!

How’s everything? I hope you’re great.

Today we are glad to introduce to you Ankora: Lost Days, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=cx36e3]our new project on Kickstarter[/url]. Maybe you already know Mûn, helping little Arco with his adventures on Deiland: Pocket Planet, but you have never seen Mûn like this before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022819/7b90cbdecce51c50487dbda381cd4d18eb48517b.png[/img]

Meet Mûn as a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded in Ankora, an unknown planet after her spaceship crashes there. Ankora: Lost Days happens before the events in Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara. 

Ankora: Lost Days mixes terraforming, crafting, and exploring mechanics in a wild planet with a colorful style. Mûn must learn to overcome obstacles: rivers, lakes and waterfalls, mountains, level jumps... And many monsters. She will soon learn to make her own paths because Ankora is a unique and changing planet.

For this new campaign, we have prepared a lot of goodies and rewards, even a physical edition for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 that also includes Deiland: Pocket Planet, thanks to the partnership with Tesura Games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022819/a9d81af189e4e485e6327b361be43375b69abb47.jpg[/img]

Also, for the first 48 hours, we have a special [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=cx36e3]Early Reward[/url] with a free digital copy of the Ankora Artbook. So hurry up before the time ends!

See you in Ankora!
